title: POSITIONAL FOOTBALL CHAMPIONSHIP LIMITED-TIME EVENT OPEN
lines: 01 POSITIONAL FOOTBALL CHAMPIONSHIP LIMITED-TIME EVENT OPEN
DURATION: November 23, 2026, 08:00 – December 7, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Theme 1-10

DETAILS: The Positional Football Championship event stages will be open for a limited time. You can obtain Championship Point Tickets by clearing event stages, and increase Championship Trophy rank level to obtain event rewards.
[Championship Trophies]
DURATION: November 23, 2026, 08:00 – December 10, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
REWARDS: MARTHE Sports Line - Bouncing Rhythms for Wulfenite, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, etc.
02 LIMITED SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: November 23, 2026, 08:00 – December 3, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 7 days to receive generous rewards, including Emergency Sanity Concentrate, Orundum, Materials, and more. Participate in the 'Sweet VS Salty Showdown' cheering event in the first 5 days to receive a furniture reward matching your preferred flavor.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 2: Orundum * 200, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Chip Catalyst * 1, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 4: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1
Day 5: Skill Summary - 1 * 30, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 6: Furniture Part * 300, Pure Gold * 20
Day 7: Module Data Block * 1, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
Note:
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
- Your taste preferences will affect which style your furniture reward comes in (Sweetsalt Liberal Doctors will get the reward of the winning side). Only one piece of furniture can be obtained.
